mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting; famotidine may mask GI symptoms of amphotericin B toxicity and both drugs can contribute to renal dysfunction and hypomagnesemia.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially magnesium and potassium), and fluid status closely; consider alternative acid suppression if possible; ensure adequate hydration and nephroprotective measures during amphotericin B therapy.
